data.name: Jumhaynah
data.gender_notes: Jumhaynah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jumhaynah is an Arabic name that refers to a gathering or assembly, often in a spiritual or religious context. It symbolizes unity and togetherness. The name Jumhaynah carries the meaning “Gathering, Assembly” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jumhaynah usually hope their child will grow to embody gathering, assembly and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Jumhaynah is associated with the concept of unity and brotherhood in faith.
data.etymology: Jumhaynah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gathering, Assembly.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jumhaynah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

It is also the name of various Islamic institutions, such as schools and mosques, where people come together to learn, pray, and connect with their community.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Jumhaynah holds spiritual significance as it represents the concept of unity and gathering in Islam. Muslims believe that gathering for worship and learning is a essential part of their faith. The name also reminds us of the important spiritual value of coming together as a community to support and uplift one another, and to seek closeness to Allah through collective worship and good deeds.
